layout: Golden vectors for FleetRing placement spec v1. The file is append-only: new cases go at the end, and existing cases never change (placement-v1.lock freezes them).

64-bit values are strings, so that every JSON parser reads them exactly: seeds, hash digests, draws x, and fingerprints are 16 lowercase hex digits; loads, item loads, and capacities are decimal digits.
Keys are their raw bytes in lowercase hex, so empty and non-UTF-8 keys can be written.
xxh3_64: XXH3_64bits_withSeed over len bytes of input under seed gives digest; byte i of the input is (31 * i + 7) mod 256.
neg_log2_q32: L(x) = l for 64-bit x (spec section 4).

cases[].ring: the hasher, strategy (rendezvous, or vnodes with tokens_per_weight), seed, replication factor, and nodes. Nodes appear in the order supplied, which is not always canonical order (spec section 2). A node without a zone is in the default zone, and a node without a host is a host of its own.
cases[].keys: each key's replica set at the ring's replication factor, preferred primary first (spec sections 5 to 7).
cases[].filters: the down nodes are ineligible (spec section 8); each key's replica set among the other nodes, empty when every node is down.

cases[].bounded: bounded-load placements (spec section 9). headroom is the percentage epsilon, item_load is the load of the key being placed, loads lists node loads (unlisted nodes have load 0), and capacity is every node's capacity for this item load. Each key's placement lists its replicas, whether it is saturated, and whether it is home.

xxh3_64.input: byte i of the input is (31 * i + 7) mod 256

cases.name: rendezvous-single-node
cases.description: One node holds every key, alone, although R is 3.

cases.name: rendezvous-two-nodes-r3
cases.description: Two equal nodes with R = 3: every replica set holds both nodes, in the key's order.

cases.name: rendezvous-equal-weights
cases.description: Eight nodes of weight 1 under seed 0: equal weights rank by raw draw.

cases.name: rendezvous-equal-weights-seed-1
cases.description: The equal-weight ring under seed 1, which changes every node hash and draw.

cases.name: rendezvous-equal-weights-seed-golden
cases.description: The equal-weight ring under a seed whose bytes all differ.

cases.name: rendezvous-equal-weights-seed-max
cases.description: The equal-weight ring under seed 2^64 - 1.

cases.name: rendezvous-uniform-weight-7
cases.description: Six nodes that all weigh 7 rank exactly as if they all weighed 1.

cases.name: rendezvous-skewed-1-vs-1000
cases.description: Weights 1 and 1000 with R = 2: the heavy node is almost always the primary.

cases.name: rendezvous-mixed-weights
cases.description: Weights 1, 10, 10, 100, and 1000: ranks compare logarithms scaled by weight, and the two nodes of weight 10 may compare raw draws instead (spec section 5).

cases.name: rendezvous-homelab
cases.description: A home lab: two laptops and a NAS weighing 1, 2, and 4, with R = 2 under seed 7.

cases.name: rendezvous-extreme-weights
cases.description: Weights 1, 2, 2^16, 2^32 - 2, and 2^32 - 1, whose cross products need 128 bits.

cases.name: rendezvous-exact-ties
cases.description: Keys found by search whose ranks tie exactly at step 1: two equal-weight pairs with equal logarithms, and two pairs of weights 1 and 2 with equal rates. The larger raw draw goes first (spec section 5, step 2).

cases.name: rendezvous-r1
cases.description: R = 1: each replica set is the preferred primary alone.

cases.name: rendezvous-r255
cases.description: R = 255 exceeds the 12 nodes, so every replica set is the key's whole preference list: zones first, then hosts, then the rest.

cases.name: rendezvous-zones-fewer-than-r
cases.description: Two zones of three nodes with R = 3: the first two replicas cover both zones, and the third comes from the host pass.

cases.name: rendezvous-zones-equal-r
cases.description: Three zones of two nodes with R = 3: each replica set covers every zone.

cases.name: rendezvous-zones-more-than-r
cases.description: Five zones of two nodes with R = 3: every replica is in a different zone.

cases.name: rendezvous-default-and-named-zones
cases.description: Nodes without a zone share the default zone, which counts as one zone beside z1 and z2.

cases.name: rendezvous-shared-hosts
cases.description: One zone; hosts h1, h2, and h3 hold 3, 2, and 1 nodes, and one node is its own host. With R = 4 the host pass picks three replicas.

cases.name: rendezvous-zones-and-hosts
cases.description: Three zones, each with two shared hosts and one unlabeled node, weights 1 to 4, and R = 5.

cases.name: rendezvous-skewed-zones
cases.description: Zones of 10, 10, and 2 nodes with R = 3: one replica of every key lands in the small zone.

cases.name: rendezvous-byte-order-ids
cases.description: IDs supplied out of order, sorted bytewise (node-10 before node-2), using every ID byte and the 1- and 64-byte length limits.

cases.name: rendezvous-fleet-64
cases.description: 64 nodes in four zones with paired hosts and weights 1 to 4 under seed 42; filters take down zone z1 and three single nodes.

cases.name: rendezvous-probe-keys
cases.description: The 64 fingerprint probe keys, so a port can compare each probe's replica set (spec section 11).

cases.name: rendezvous-key-lengths
cases.description: Keys of every XXH3 input-length class, 0 to 1024 bytes, mostly not UTF-8.

cases.name: rendezvous-failover
cases.description: Three zones of three nodes: filters take down one node, a whole zone, all nodes but one, and every node.

cases.name: rendezvous-bounded-equal
cases.description: Bounded loads on six equal nodes: room everywhere, one overloaded node, an exact fit at zero headroom, no room anywhere, and room on a single node.

cases.name: rendezvous-bounded-zones
cases.description: Bounded loads across three weighted zones: replicas keep zone diversity among the nodes with room, and saturated placements fill from the zone-diverse preference list.

cases.name: rendezvous-bounded-extremes
cases.description: Bounded loads at the limits: weights up to 2^32 - 1, loads and items near 2^64 so that the total exceeds 2^64, headroom 0, 1, and 65535, and an item load of 0.

cases.name: rendezvous-bounded-fewer-nodes-than-r
cases.description: Bounded loads with three nodes and R = 5: placements hold all three nodes, and are saturated only when some replica lacks room.

cases.name: vnodes-single-node
cases.description: A vnode ring of one node with one token: every key maps to it.

cases.name: vnodes-one-token-each
cases.description: Six nodes with one token each: plain consistent hashing.

cases.name: vnodes-weighted
cases.description: Weights 1, 2, 3, and 5 at two tokens per weight unit: 22 tokens.

cases.name: vnodes-zones-fewer-than-r
cases.description: A vnode ring with two zones of three nodes and R = 3: the third replica comes from the host pass.

cases.name: vnodes-zones-equal-r
cases.description: A vnode ring with three zones of two nodes and R = 3.

cases.name: vnodes-zones-more-than-r
cases.description: A vnode ring with five zones and R = 3.

cases.name: vnodes-shared-hosts
cases.description: A vnode ring in one zone where hosts hold 3, 2, and 1 nodes and one node is its own host, with R = 4.

cases.name: vnodes-default-tokens
cases.description: The default 256 tokens per weight unit, with weights 1, 1, 2, and 3: 1792 tokens.

cases.name: vnodes-seed-golden
cases.description: A vnode ring under a seed whose bytes all differ.

cases.name: vnodes-seed-max
cases.description: A vnode ring under seed 2^64 - 1.

cases.name: vnodes-skewed-1-vs-1000
cases.description: Weights 1 and 1000 at one token per weight unit, with R = 2.

cases.name: vnodes-r255
cases.description: A vnode ring with R = 255 over 12 nodes: every replica set is the whole preference list.

cases.name: vnodes-byte-order-ids
cases.description: A vnode ring whose IDs are supplied out of order and sort bytewise.

cases.name: vnodes-failover
cases.description: A vnode ring of three zones of three nodes: filters take down one node, a whole zone, all nodes but one, and every node.

cases.name: vnodes-bounded
cases.description: Bounded loads on a vnode ring of six equal nodes: one overloaded node, no room anywhere, and room on a single node.

cases.name: vnodes-key-lengths
cases.description: A vnode ring under seed 1 with keys of every XXH3 input-length class.

cases.name: vnodes-probe-keys
cases.description: A vnode ring with the 64 fingerprint probe keys.

cases.name: vnodes-r1
cases.description: A vnode ring with R = 1 and 16 tokens per weight unit.

cases.name: vnodes-zones-and-hosts
cases.description: A vnode ring with three zones, each with two shared hosts and one unlabeled node, weights 1 to 4, and R = 5.
